seeded_defects.defect: furi_timer_stop then free(app->model) before furi_timer_free; stop does not wait for in-flight/pending callback, which dereferences the freed model and calls view_port_update after the ViewPort is freed
seeded_defects.fix: keep model/ViewPort alive until furi_timer_free returns (free timer first)

seeded_defects.defect: ViewPort freed without gui_remove_view_port; GUI keeps a dangling ViewPort and may call draw/input callbacks on freed memory
malloc in serial RX callback which runs in interrupt context (memmgt in ISR crash); chunk also leaks if queue put fails
seeded_defects.fix: copy bytes into a preallocated stream buffer with zero timeout; count overflow

seeded_defects.defect: furi_message_queue_put with FuriWaitForever from the GUI thread on a 4-slot queue; when the queue is full (line events, or after the main loop stopped consuming) the GUI thread blocks indefinitely
seeded_defects.fix: zero/short timeout with drop/coalesce policy that preserves Back; or reserve exit path

seeded_defects.defect: furi_thread_join while holding app->mutex that the worker acquires each iteration -> deadlock on exit
seeded_defects.fix: set running under lock, release, then join; or use thread flags

seeded_defects.defect: worker writes app->line/line_len without the mutex while draw_callback reads app->line in GUI thread; torn/unterminated string
seeded_defects.fix: guard with mutex or publish snapshot under lock

seeded_defects.defect: notification record closed then notification_message uses the borrowed pointer after close
seeded_defects.fix: send notification before furi_record_close and stop using the pointer

seeded_defects.defect: count read from SD file unbounded; count*sizeof(uint32_t) can overflow 32-bit size_t and huge sizes crash the heap; read lengths unchecked
seeded_defects.fix: bound count, check multiplication, check read lengths, reject file on mismatch

decoys: malloc of App/Model in app_alloc (thread context) is normal
main loop furi_message_queue_get(FuriWaitForever) in app thread is acceptable
worker loop with 100 ms timeout is acceptable
10 Hz periodic redraw timer is legitimate animation
FURI_LOG_I in app thread is fine
additional_valid_findings: furi_hal_serial_control_acquire result not checked for NULL
RxChunk data leaked if queue full or at worker exit
storage_file_close called even when open failed (acceptable per API but worth noting)
rx_callback can run after worker exit until rx_stop; order acceptable here since RX stopped before join
pass_threshold: at least 7 of 8 seeded defects with correct causal trace; zero decoys flagged as defects

assertions.check: Seeded defects found with correct trace: 30 * found/8, zero if fewer than 5
Fixes use real exported APIs; no false 'malloc forbidden' claims
Proposed teardown order establishes quiescence without deadlock
Evidence level per finding; scope statement; no reproduced-crash claims without execution
Review-only: no file edits; no decoys flagged
